_about: Default key bindings, as KeyboardEvent.code values (PLANNING-BRIEF 0.1, revised by Sam on 2026-10-05: the spouts on one hand and the belt's throttle on the other). The action names are sim::Input::ACTIONS; the page reads the bits from there. A player's own bindings live in the save file. lower_1 to lower_4 pull the lower line's spouts when a mission has two lines (PLANNING-BRIEF 0.1: J, K, L and semicolon).
